title: 94. How do I add useful links to my survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I add useful links to my survey.
short_answer: Open your survey, go to the 'Properties' page and select 'Advanced' section. Add labels and URLs under 'Useful links'. These links will appear on every page on the right-hand side of your survey. If you have already published your survey, please remember to go to the 'Overview' page and click on 'Apply Changes'.
